answer: The admission bond is time locked for 11 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are published in thread, expire in marble, and sonnet lists each expiry. Someone running 55 aliases hence needs 11 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1623 identities would post 2398 proofs and burn roughly 54 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
